actions.name: Access Modeling
actions.description: Access modeling captures and records the access permissions granted to identities (e.g., administrators, users, groups, systems) and optionally includes details on how these identities are stored, managed, and shared across systems.

actions.name: Biometric Authentication
actions.description: Using biological measures in order to authenticate a user.

actions.name: Authentication Event Thresholding
actions.description: Collecting authentication events, creating a baseline user profile, and determining whether authentication events are consistent with the baseline profile.

actions.name: Authorization Event Thresholding
actions.description: Collecting authorization events, creating a baseline user profile, and determining whether authorization events are consistent with the baseline profile.

actions.name: Credential Compromise Scope Analysis
actions.description: Determining which credentials may have been compromised by analyzing the user logon history of a particular system.

actions.name: User Confirmation
actions.description: Require manual authorization for sensitive actions.

actions.name: Human Approval
actions.description: Require user consent for privileged actions.

actions.name: Authentication Identities
actions.description: Use OAuth2 and API Keys for custom authorization.

actions.name: human-in-the-Loop
actions.description: Require human approval for actions.

actions.name: Deploy advanced verification mechanisms
actions.description: Deploy advanced content verification mechanisms, such as digital signatures and trusted identity frameworks, to ensure the authenticity of content and identities, preventing AI systems from making decisions based on spoofed or false data.
